name: Patch
_about: A PATCH sewn on the torso in the garment's own cloth: a pocket, a waistband, a welt, a rib, a lapel -- from `from` to `to`, closed round it or (`open`) over `span` degrees about `centre` (0 the front, 90 the left), `thick` standing proud; a `neckline` cut from it when it says (a rib round the collar). Used AFTER the body it lies on: a garment's own pieces lie under its components' (clothes.js piecesOf lists them first).
